reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2038 b, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ، - يَعْنِي الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ سَلَمَةَ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ بَيْنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ قَاعِدٌ وَعُمَرُ مَعَهُ إِذْ أَتَاهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَقْعَدَكُمَا هَا هُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالاَ أَخْرَجَنَا الْجُوعُ مِنْ بُيُوتِنَا وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ خَلَفِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me, Abu Hisham—meaning al-Mughirah ibn Salamah—informed us, 'Abd al-Wahid ibn Ziyad narrated to us, Yazid narrated to us, Abu Hazim narrated to us, he said: I heard Abu Hurayrah say: While Abu Bakr was sitting and 'Umar was with him, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) came to them and said: "What caused the two of you to sit here?" They said: "By the One Who sent you with the truth, hunger drove us out of our houses." Then he mentioned something similar to the hadith of Khalaf ibn Khalifah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2039, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، مِنْ رُقْعَةٍ عَارَضَ لِي بِهَا ثُمَّ قَرَأَهُ عَلَىَّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَاهُ حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ لَمَّا حُفِرَ الْخَنْدَقُ رَأَيْتُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمَصًا فَانْكَفَأْتُ إِلَى امْرَأَتِي فَقُلْتُ لَهَا هَلْ عِنْدَكِ شَىْءٌ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمَصًا شَدِيدًا ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ لِي جِرَابًا فِيهِ صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ وَلَنَا بُهَيْمَةٌ دَاجِنٌ - قَالَ - فَذَبَحْتُهَا وَطَحَنَتْ فَفَرَغَتْ إِلَى فَرَاغِي فَقَطَّعْتُهَا فِي بُرْمَتِهَا ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَفْضَحْنِي بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنْ مَعَهُ - قَالَ - فَجِئْتُهُ فَسَارَرْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا قَدْ ذَبَحْنَا بُهَيْمَةً لَنَا وَطَحَنَتْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ كَانَ عِنْدَنَا فَتَعَالَ أَنْتَ فِي نَفَرٍ مَعَكَ ‏.‏ فَصَاحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَهْلَ الْخَنْدَقِ إِنَّ جَابِرًا قَدْ صَنَعَ لَكُمْ سُورًا فَحَيَّهَلاَ بِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُنْزِلُنَّ بُرْمَتَكُمْ وَلاَ تَخْبِزُنَّ عَجِينَتَكُمْ حَتَّى أَجِيءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْدُمُ النَّاسَ حَتَّى جِئْتُ امْرَأَتِي فَقَالَتْ بِكَ وَبِكَ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ الَّذِي قُلْتِ لِي ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجْتُ لَهُ عَجِينَتَنَا فَبَصَقَ فِيهَا وَبَارَكَ ثُمَّ عَمَدَ إِلَى بُرْمَتِنَا فَبَصَقَ فِيهَا وَبَارَكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعِي خَابِزَةً فَلْتَخْبِزْ مَعَكِ وَاقْدَحِي مِنْ بُرْمَتِكُمْ وَلاَ تُنْزِلُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَهُمْ أَلْفٌ فَأُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ لأَكَلُوا حَتَّى تَرَكُوهُ وَانْحَرَفُوا وَإِنَّ بُرْمَتَنَا لَتَغِطُّ كَمَا هِيَ وَإِنَّ عَجِينَتَنَا - أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ - لَتُخْبَزُ كَمَا هُوَ ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj ibn al-Sha'ir narrated to me, al-Dahhak ibn Makhlad narrated to me from a written paper that he compared with mine and then recited to me, saying: Hanzalah ibn Abi Sufyan informed us, Sa'id ibn Mina' narrated to us, saying: I heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah say: When the Trench (al-Khandaq) was being dug, I saw hunger in the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). So I returned to my wife and said to her: "Do you have anything? For I saw severe hunger in the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)." She brought out a bag containing a sa' of barley, and we had a tame young sheep. He said: So I slaughtered it and she ground the barley, finishing when I finished. I cut the meat into pieces in its cooking pot, then turned to go to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). She said: "Do not humiliate me before the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and those with him!" He said: I came to him and whispered to him, saying: "O Messenger of Allah, we have slaughtered a young sheep of ours, and my wife has ground a sa' of barley that we had; so come, you and a small group with you." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) called out loudly, saying: "O people of the Trench, Jabir has prepared a feast for you, so come welcome!" And the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Do not take down your cooking pot and do not bake your dough until I arrive." So I arrived, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) arrived leading the people, until I entered upon my wife. She said: "May this befall you and that!" I said: "I did what you told me." She brought out our dough for him, and he spat into it and blessed it; then he went to our cooking pot, spat into it and blessed it, then said: "Call another woman to bake with you, and ladle out from your cooking pot, but do not take it off the fire." And they were one thousand people! I swear by Allah, they ate until they left it and went away, while our cooking pot was still boiling as it had been, and our dough—or as al-Dahhak said—was still being baked as it had been!

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 a, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ لأُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ قَدْ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَعِيفًا أَعْرِفُ فِيهِ الْجُوعَ فَهَلْ عِنْدَكِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ أَقْرَاصًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ ثُمَّ أَخَذَتْ خِمَارًا لَهَا فَلَفَّتِ الْخُبْزَ بِبَعْضِهِ ثُمَّ دَسَّتْهُ تَحْتَ ثَوْبِي وَرَدَّتْنِي بِبَعْضِهِ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَتْنِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ بِهِ فَوَجَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَعَهُ النَّاسُ فَقُمْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرْسَلَكَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلِطَعَامٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمَنْ مَعَهُ ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقْتُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ حَتَّى جِئْتُ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ قَدْ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالنَّاسِ وَلَيْسَ عِنْدَنَا مَا نُطْعِمُهُمْ فَقَالَتِ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ حَتَّى لَقِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلاَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلُمِّي مَا عِنْدَكِ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَتْ بِذَلِكَ الْخُبْزِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَفُتَّ وَعَصَرَتْ عَلَيْهِ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ عُكَّةً لَهَا فَأَدَمَتْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حَتَّى أَكَلَ الْقَوْمُ كُلُّهُمْ وَشَبِعُوا وَالْقَوْمُ سَبْعُونَ رَجُلاً أَوْ ثَمَانُونَ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, he said: I read to Malik ibn Anas, from Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, that he heard Anas ibn Malik say: Abu Talhah said to Umm Sulaym: "I heard the voice of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) sounding weak, and I recognized hunger in it. Do you have anything?" She said: "Yes." She brought out some barley loaves, took a veil of hers and wrapped the bread in part of it, tucked it under my garment, and wrapped me with the rest of it, then sent me to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). He said: I went with it and found the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) sitting in the mosque with people around him. I stood near them, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Has Abu Talhah sent you?" I said: "Yes." He said: "With a meal?" I said: "Yes." The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said to those who were with him: "Stand up." He said: So he set out and I walked ahead of them until I reached Abu Talhah and informed him. Abu Talhah said: "O Umm Sulaym, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) has brought the people, and we have nothing to feed them!" She said: "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said: Abu Talhah went out until he met the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) approached with him until they entered. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Bring what you have, O Umm Sulaym." She brought that bread, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) ordered it broken into crumbs. Umm Sulaym squeezed a butter-skin of hers over it to season it. Then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said over it whatever Allah willed that he say, and then said: "Admit ten." He admitted them, and they ate until they were full, then left. Then he said: "Admit ten." He admitted them, and they ate until they were full, then left. Then he said: "Admit ten," until all the people ate and were full, and the people were seventy or eighty men.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 b, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَدْعُوَهُ وَقَدْ جَعَلَ طَعَامًا - قَالَ - فَأَقْبَلْتُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ النَّاسِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَىَّ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ فَقُلْتُ أَجِبْ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا صَنَعْتُ لَكَ شَيْئًا - قَالَ - فَمَسَّهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَدَعَا فِيهَا بِالْبَرَكَةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَدْخِلْ نَفَرًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِي عَشَرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا فَخَرَجُوا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَدْخِلْ عَشَرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ‏.‏ فَمَا زَالَ يُدْخِلُ عَشَرَةً وَيُخْرِجُ عَشَرَةً حَتَّى لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ دَخَلَ فَأَكَلَ حَتَّى شَبِعَ ثُمَّ هَيَّأَهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ مِثْلُهَا حِينَ أَكَلُوا مِنْهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us; (H) and Ibn Numayr narrated to us—and the wording is his—my father narrated to us, Sa'd ibn Sa'id narrated to us, Anas ibn Malik narrated to me, saying: Abu Talhah sent me to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) to invite him, having prepared some food. He said: I came while the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was with the people. He looked at me, so I felt shy and said: "Answer Abu Talhah's invitation." He said to the people: "Stand up." Abu Talhah said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have only prepared a little food for you." He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) touched it and supplicated for blessing in it, then said: "Admit a group of my Companions, ten of them." And he said: "Eat," and brought out something for them from between his fingers. They ate until they were full and then left. Then he said: "Admit ten." So they ate until they were full. He kept admitting ten and letting ten out until not one of them remained except that he had entered and eaten until full. Then he gathered it together, and behold, it was just as it had been when they first ate from it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 c, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي آخِرِهِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مَا بَقِيَ فَجَمَعَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا فِيهِ بِالْبَرَكَةِ - قَالَ - فَعَادَ كَمَا كَانَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دُونَكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi narrated to me, my father narrated to me, Sa'd ibn Sa'id narrated to us, he said: I heard Anas ibn Malik say: Abu Talhah sent me to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)... and he related the hadith in the manner of the hadith of Ibn Numayr, except that he said at its end: "Then he took what remained, gathered it, and prayed for blessing in it—he said—and it returned to what it had been. Then he said: 'Take this.'"

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 d, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ أَنْ تَصْنَعَ، لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا لِنَفْسِهِ خَاصَّةً ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَوَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ وَسَمَّى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَدَخَلُوا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُوا وَسَمُّوا اللَّهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِثَمَانِينَ رَجُلاً ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَأَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَتَرَكُوا سُؤْرًا ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to me, 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Raqqi narrated to us, 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Amr narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Umayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: Abu Talhah ordered Umm Sulaym to prepare food specifically for the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) himself, and then sent me to him... and he related the hadith, saying therein: The Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) placed his hand upon it and mentioned the Name of Allah over it, then said: "Admit ten." So he admitted them, and they entered. He said: "Eat and mention the Name of Allah." So they ate, until he did that for eighty men. Then the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and the people of the household ate after that, and they left leftovers.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 e, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، ‏.‏ بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ فِي طَعَامِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَقَامَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ عَلَى الْبَابِ حَتَّى أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا كَانَ شَىْءٌ يَسِيرٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلُمَّهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيَجْعَلُ فِيهِ الْبَرَكَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, 'Abdullah ibn Maslamah narrated to us, 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Muhammad narrated to us, from 'Amr ibn Yahya, from his father, from Anas ibn Malik, with this story concerning the food of Abu Talhah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he said therein: Abu Talhah stood at the door until the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) arrived, and said to him: "O Messenger of Allah, it was only a little bit of food." He said: "Bring it forward, for Allah will surely place blessing in it."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 f, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ الْبَجَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَقَالَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكَلَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَأَفْضَلُوا مَا أَبْلَغُوا جِيرَانَهُمْ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, Khalid ibn Makhlad al-Bajali narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Musa narrated to me, 'Abdullah ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah narrated to me, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), with this hadith, and he said therein: "Then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) ate, and the people of the household ate, and they left over what they could send to their neighbors."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 g, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ جَرِيرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَى أَبُو طَلْحَةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَتَقَلَّبُ ظَهْرًا لِبَطْنٍ فَأَتَى أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَتَقَلَّبُ ظَهْرًا لِبَطْنٍ وَأَظُنُّهُ جَائِعًا ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ وَأُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ وَأَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ وَفَضَلَتْ فَضْلَةٌ فَأَهْدَيْنَاهُ لِجِيرَانِنَا ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Hulwani narrated to us, Wahb ibn Jarir narrated to us, my father narrated to us, he said: I heard Jarir ibn Zayd narrating from 'Amr ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: Abu Talhah saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) lying down in the mosque tossing and turning from back to stomach. He went to Umm Sulaym and said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) lying down in the mosque tossing and turning from back to stomach, and I think he is hungry." And he related the hadith, saying therein: "Then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), Abu Talhah, Umm Sulaym, and Anas ibn Malik ate, and there remained leftovers, which we gifted to our neighbors."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 h, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، أَنَّحَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ جِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَوَجَدْتُهُ جَالِسًا مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ يُحَدِّثُهُمْ وَقَدْ عَصَّبَ بَطْنَهُ بِعِصَابَةٍ - قَالَ أُسَامَةُ وَأَنَا أَشُكُّ - عَلَى حَجَرٍ فَقُلْتُ لِبَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ لِمَ عَصَّبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَطْنَهُ فَقَالُوا مِنَ الْجُوعِ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَهُوَ زَوْجُ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَتَاهُ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَصَّبَ بَطْنَهُ بِعِصَابَةٍ فَسَأَلْتُ بَعْضَ أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالُوا مِنَ الْجُوعِ ‏.‏ فَدَخَلَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ عَلَى أُمِّي فَقَالَ هَلْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ عِنْدِي كِسَرٌ مِنْ خُبْزٍ وَتَمَرَاتٌ فَإِنْ جَاءَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحْدَهُ أَشْبَعْنَاهُ وَإِنْ جَاءَ آخَرُ مَعَهُ قَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ سَائِرَ الْحَدِيثِ بِقِصَّتِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi narrated to me, 'Abdullah ibn Wahb narrated to us, Usamah informed me that Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah narrated to him that he heard Anas ibn Malik say: I came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) one day and found him sitting with his Companions talking to them, having bound his stomach with a band—Usamah said: and I doubt whether it was over a stone. I said to some of his Companions: "Why has the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) bound his stomach?" They said: "From hunger." So I went to Abu Talhah, who was the husband of Umm Sulaym bint Milhan, and said: "O father! I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) having bound his stomach with a band, and I asked some of his Companions and they said: 'From hunger.'" Abu Talhah entered upon my mother and said: "Is there anything?" She said: "Yes, I have some pieces of bread and dates; if the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) comes to us alone, we can satisfy him, but if someone else comes with him, it will be too little for them." Then he mentioned the rest of the hadith with its story.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2040 i, book 36, باب جَوَازِ اسْتِتْبَاعِهِ غَيْرَهُ إِلَى دَارِ مَنْ يَثِقُ بِرِضَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَيَتَحَقَّقُهُ تَحَقُّقًا تَامًّا وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الاِجْتِمَاعِ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَعَامِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj ibn al-Sha'ir narrated to me, Yunus ibn Muhammad narrated to us, Harb ibn Maymun narrated to us, from al-Nadr ibn Anas, from Anas ibn Malik, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), concerning the meal of Abu Talhah, something similar to their hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2041 a, book 36, باب جَوَازِ أَكْلِ الْمَرَقِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ أَكْلِ الْيَقْطِينِ وَإِيثَارِ أَهْلِ الْمَائِدَةِ بَعْضِهِمْ بَعْضًا وَإِنْ كَانُوا ضِيفَانًا إِذَا لَمْ يَكْرَهْ ذَلِكَ صَاحِبُ الطَّعَامِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ خَيَّاطًا دَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِطَعَامٍ صَنَعَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَذَهَبْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى ذَلِكَ الطَّعَامِ فَقَرَّبَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خُبْزًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ وَمَرَقًا فِيهِ دُبَّاءٌ وَقَدِيدٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَتَبَّعُ الدُّبَّاءَ مِنْ حَوَالَىِ الصَّحْفَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أُحِبُّ الدُّبَّاءَ مُنْذُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Malik ibn Anas—in what was recited to him—from Ishaq ibn 'Abdullah ibn Abi Talhah, that he heard Anas ibn Malik say: A tailor invited the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) to a meal he had prepared. Anas ibn Malik said: I went along with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) to that meal. He served the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) barley bread and soup containing gourd and cured meat (qadid). Anas said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) following the pieces of gourd around the edges of the dish. He said: Ever since that day, I have always loved gourd.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2041 b, book 36, باب جَوَازِ أَكْلِ الْمَرَقِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ أَكْلِ الْيَقْطِينِ وَإِيثَارِ أَهْلِ الْمَائِدَةِ بَعْضِهِمْ بَعْضًا وَإِنْ كَانُوا ضِيفَانًا إِذَا لَمْ يَكْرَهْ ذَلِكَ صَاحِبُ الطَّعَامِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ دَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فَجِيءَ بِمَرَقَةٍ فِيهَا دُبَّاءٌ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الدُّبَّاءِ وَيُعْجِبُهُ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ جَعَلْتُ أُلْقِيهِ إِلَيْهِ وَلاَ أَطْعَمُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ فَمَا زِلْتُ بَعْدُ يُعْجِبُنِي الدُّبَّاءُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-'Ala' Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah, from Thabit, from Anas, who said: A man invited the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), so I went along with him. Soup containing gourd was brought, and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) began eating of that gourd and it pleased him. He said: When I saw that, I began putting pieces of gourd toward him and not eating any of it myself. Anas said: "Ever since, gourd has continued to please me."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2041 c, book 36, باب جَوَازِ أَكْلِ الْمَرَقِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ أَكْلِ الْيَقْطِينِ وَإِيثَارِ أَهْلِ الْمَائِدَةِ بَعْضِهِمْ بَعْضًا وَإِنْ كَانُوا ضِيفَانًا إِذَا لَمْ يَكْرَهْ ذَلِكَ صَاحِبُ الطَّعَامِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، وَعَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، خَيَّاطًا دَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَزَادَ قَالَ ثَابِتٌ فَسَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ فَمَا صُنِعَ لِي طَعَامٌ بَعْدُ أَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ يُصْنَعَ فِيهِ دُبَّاءٌ إِلاَّ صُنِعَ ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj ibn al-Sha'ir and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me, both from 'Abd al-Razzaq, Ma'mar informed us, from Thabit al-Bunani and 'Asim al-Ahwal, from Anas ibn Malik, that a tailor invited the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)... and he added: Thabit said: I heard Anas say: "Afterward, no food was ever prepared for me where gourd could possibly be put into it except that it was put into it."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2042 a, book 36, باب اسْتِحْبَابِ وَضْعِ النَّوَى خَارِجَ التَّمْرِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ دُعَاءِ الضَّيْفِ لأَهْلِ الطَّعَامِ وَطَلَبِ الدُّعَاءِ مِنَ الضَّيْفِ الصَّالِحِ وَإِجَابَتِهِ لِذَلِكَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ، قَالَ نَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أَبِي - قَالَ - فَقَرَّبْنَا إِلَيْهِ طَعَامًا وَوَطْبَةً فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِتَمْرٍ فَكَانَ يَأْكُلُهُ وَيُلْقِي النَّوَى بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ وَيَجْمَعُ السَّبَّابَةَ وَالْوُسْطَى - قَالَ شُعْبَةُ هُوَ ظَنِّي وَهُوَ فِيهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ إِلْقَاءُ النَّوَى بَيْنَ الإِصْبَعَيْنِ - ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِشَرَابٍ فَشَرِبَهُ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهُ الَّذِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ أَبِي وَأَخَذَ بِلِجَامِ دَابَّتِهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna al-'Anazi narrated to me, Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from Yazid ibn Khumayr, from 'Abdullah ibn Busr, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) came as a guest to my father. He said: So we presented to him food and watbah (a dish of dates, curd, and butter), and he ate from it. Then dates were brought to him, and he began eating them and casting the stones between his two fingers, joining the index finger and the middle finger—Shu'bah said: "It is my presumption, and it is in it, if Allah wills: casting the stones between the two fingers"—then a drink was brought, so he drank it and passed it to the one on his right. He said: Then my father took the reins of his riding beast and said: "Supplicate to Allah for us." So he said: "O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy upon them."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2042 b, book 36, باب اسْتِحْبَابِ وَضْعِ النَّوَى خَارِجَ التَّمْرِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ دُعَاءِ الضَّيْفِ لأَهْلِ الطَّعَامِ وَطَلَبِ الدُّعَاءِ مِنَ الضَّيْفِ الصَّالِحِ وَإِجَابَتِهِ لِذَلِكَ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّا فِي إِلْقَاءِ النَّوَى بَيْنَ الإِصْبَعَيْنِ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, Ibn Abi 'Adiyy narrated to us; (H) and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to me, Yahya ibn Hammad narrated to us, both from Shu'bah, with this chain of narration, and neither of them doubted about casting the date-stones between the two fingers.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2043, book 36, باب أَكْلِ الْقِثَّاءِ بِالرُّطَبِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ الْهِلاَلِيُّ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا - إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ الْقُثَّاءَ بِالرُّطَبِ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi and 'Abdullah ibn 'Awn al-Hilali narrated to us—Yahya said: "informed us," and Ibn 'Awn said: "narrated to us"—Ibrahim ibn Sa'd, from his father, from 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far, who said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) eating cucumbers with fresh ripe dates.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2044 a, book 36, باب اسْتِحْبَابِ تَوَاضُعِ الآكِلِ وَصِفَةِ قُعُودِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُقْعِيًا يَأْكُلُ تَمْرًا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to us, both from Hafs—Abu Bakr said: Hafs ibn Ghiyath narrated to us, from Mus'ab ibn Sulaym, Anas ibn Malik narrated to us, saying: I saw the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) squatting on his heels (muq'iyan) eating dates.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2044 b, book 36, باب اسْتِحْبَابِ تَوَاضُعِ الآكِلِ وَصِفَةِ قُعُودِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَمْرٍ فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْسِمُهُ وَهُوَ مُحْتَفِزٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَكْلاً ذَرِيعًا ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ زُهَيْرٍ أَكْلاً حَثِيثًا ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated to us, both from Sufyan—Ibn Abi 'Umar said: Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah narrated to us, from Mus'ab ibn Sulaym, from Anas, who said: Dates were brought to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) began distributing them while sitting alertly on his haunches (muhtafizan), eating from them quickly. And in the narration of Zuhayr: "eating briskly."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2045 a, book 36, باب نَهْيِ الآكِلِ مَعَ جَمَاعَةٍ عَنْ قِرَانِ تَمْرَتَيْنِ وَنَحْوِهِمَا فِي لُقْمَةٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ أَصْحَابِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَبَلَةَ، بْنَ سُحَيْمٍ قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَرْزُقُنَا التَّمْرَ - قَالَ - وَقَدْ كَانَ أَصَابَ النَّاسَ يَوْمَئِذٍ جُهْدٌ وَكُنَّا نَأْكُلُ فَيَمُرُّ عَلَيْنَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَنَحْنُ نَأْكُلُ فَيَقُولُ لاَ تُقَارِنُوا فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الإِقْرَانِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْتَأْذِنَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ لاَ أُرَى هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةَ إِلاَّ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الاِسْتِئْذَانَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, he said: I heard Jabalah ibn Suhaym say: Ibn al-Zubayr used to provide us with dates—he said—and people at that time had been stricken by hardship. We would be eating and Ibn 'Umar would pass by us while we were eating and say: "Do not eat two dates at a time, for the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade eating two dates together (iqran), unless a man asks permission from his brother." Shu'bah said: "I think this phrase is only from the words of Ibn 'Umar"—meaning asking permission.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2045 b, book 36, باب نَهْيِ الآكِلِ مَعَ جَمَاعَةٍ عَنْ قِرَانِ تَمْرَتَيْنِ وَنَحْوِهِمَا فِي لُقْمَةٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ أَصْحَابِهِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا قَوْلُ شُعْبَةَ وَلاَ قَوْلُهُ وَقَدْ كَانَ أَصَابَ النَّاسَ يَوْمَئِذٍ جَهْدٌ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated it to us, my father narrated to us; (H) and Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us, both from Shu'bah, with this chain of narration; and there is not in the hadith of either of them the remark of Shu'bah, nor his statement: "and people had been stricken by hardship in those days."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2045 c, book 36, باب نَهْيِ الآكِلِ مَعَ جَمَاعَةٍ عَنْ قِرَانِ تَمْرَتَيْنِ وَنَحْوِهِمَا فِي لُقْمَةٍ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِ أَصْحَابِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَقْرِنَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ التَّمْرَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَسْتَأْذِنَ أَصْحَابَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me, they said: 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Jabalah ibn Suhaym, who said: I heard Ibn 'Umar saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade that a man should eat two dates together at once (qiran) until he asks permission of his companions.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2046 a, book 36, باب فِي ادْخَالِ التَّمْرِ وَنَحْوِهِ مِنَ الأَقْوَاتِ لِلْعِيَالِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، بْنُ بِلاَلٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَجُوعُ أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ عِنْدَهُمُ التَّمْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abdullah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman al-Darimi narrated to me, Yahya ibn Hassan informed us, Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to us, from Hisham ibn 'Urwah, from his father, from 'A'ishah, that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "The people of a house having dates will not go hungry."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2046 b, book 36, باب فِي ادْخَالِ التَّمْرِ وَنَحْوِهِ مِنَ الأَقْوَاتِ لِلْعِيَالِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ طَحْلاَءَ، عَنْ أَبِي، الرِّجَالِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ بَيْتٌ لاَ تَمْرَ فِيهِ جِيَاعٌ أَهْلُهُ يَا عَائِشَةُ بَيْتٌ لاَ تَمْرَ فِيهِ جِيَاعٌ أَهْلُهُ أَوْ جَاعَ أَهْلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abdullah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us, Ya'qub ibn Muhammad ibn Tahla' narrated to us, from Abu al-Rijal Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from his mother, from 'A'ishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "O 'A'ishah, a house in which there are no dates, its inhabitants are hungry. O 'A'ishah, a house in which there are no dates, its inhabitants are hungry"—or "its inhabitants go hungry." He said it twice or thrice.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2047 a, book 36, باب فَضْلِ تَمْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ سَبْعَ تَمَرَاتٍ مِمَّا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا حِينَ يُصْبِحُ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ سُمٌّ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abdullah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us, Sulayman—meaning Ibn Bilal—narrated to us, from 'Abdullah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Amir ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Whoever eats seven dates from between its two lava tracts (the two volcanic plains of Medina) in the morning, no poison will harm him until evening."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2047 b, book 36, باب فَضْلِ تَمْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هَاشِمِ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَامِرَ بْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ تَصَبَّحَ بِسَبْعِ تَمَرَاتٍ عَجْوَةً لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ سُمٌّ وَلاَ سِحْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hashim ibn Hashim, who said: I heard 'Amir ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas say: I heard Sa'd say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: "Whoever takes seven 'ajwah dates in the morning, neither poison nor sorcery will harm him on that day."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2047 c, book 36, باب فَضْلِ تَمْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَدْرٍ، شُجَاعُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هَاشِمِ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ وَلاَ يَقُولاَنِ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated it to us, Marwan ibn Mu'awiyah al-Fazari narrated to us; (H) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated it to us, Abu Badr Shuja' ibn al-Walid informed us; both from Hashim ibn Hashim, with this chain of narration, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), the like of it, and neither of them said: "I heard the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2048, book 36, باب فَضْلِ تَمْرِ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَمِرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي عَجْوَةِ الْعَالِيَةِ شِفَاءً أَوْ إِنَّهَا تِرْيَاقٌ أَوَّلَ الْبُكْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya, Yahya ibn Ayyub, and Ibn Hujr narrated to us—Yahya ibn Yahya said: "informed us," and the other two said: "narrated to us"—Isma'il—who is Ibn Ja'far—from Sharik—who is Ibn Abi Namir—from 'Abdullah ibn Abi 'Atiq, from 'A'ishah, that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: "Indeed, in the 'ajwah dates of al-'Aliyah there is healing, or they are an antidote in the early morning."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2049 a, book 36, باب فَضْلِ الْكَمْأَةِ وَمُدَاوَاةِ الْعَيْنِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، وَعُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو، بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, Jarir narrated to us; (H) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, Jarir and 'Umar ibn 'Ubayd informed us, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Umayr, from 'Amr ibn Hurayth, from Sa'id ibn Zayd ibn 'Amr ibn Nufayl, who said: I heard the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: "Truffles are a part of manna, and their water is a cure for the eye."

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 2049 b, book 36, باب فَضْلِ الْكَمْأَةِ وَمُدَاوَاةِ الْعَيْنِ بِهَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ، عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Umayr, who said: I heard 'Amr ibn Hurayth say: I heard Sa'id ibn Zayd say: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) say: "Truffles are a part of manna, and their water is a cure for the eye."
